q1.explanationZh: 文章讲了Mann的好几项发明，还引用他的话说他做的很多东西“超前于时代”，所以他是有很多超前想法的发明家。

evidence.quote: “A lot of what I do seems ahead of its time,” he says.

q2.explanationZh: 第一段说实验室每个角落都堆满电子设备，第二段Mann说他一直用各种酷酷的技术小玩意填满空间，所以充满有趣的东西。

evidence.quote: I’ve always filled my space with all kinds of cool, techy things.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说小时候学焊接时，他发现防护头盔的小窗几乎挡住了视线，也就是焊工看不清东西。

evidence.quote: The boy noticed that the small window of the protective helmet almost completely blocked his view.

q4.explanationZh: 先是少年时做出第一台可穿戴电脑（④），然后1993年发明HDR（①），再做成EyeTap（③），最后是比苹果手表早16年的智能手表电话（②）。

evidence.quote: he built his first wearable computer, the WearComp
in 1993, he came up with a solution: HDR.
With the development of HDR, it finally became the EyeTap.
Mann also created a smartwatch videophone, 16 years before the Apple Watch hit the market.

q5.explanationZh: 第五段说很多人觉得他很奇怪，有人甚至过马路躲开他，说明他们接受不了。

evidence.quote: But many people thought it was strange. Some even crossed the street to avoid Mann.

q6.explanationZh: 最后一句说“希望我们都开始倾听”，意思是以前大家没有好好听Mann的想法，没有给他足够的关注。
